description: Declarative DOM Primitive Bindings Web IDE with In-Memory Workspace Preview & Pop-out Studio
author: KeshavSoft
features: Powered by KeshavSoft dom-primitive-bindings (v5): modular bindings.json + actions.js per domain folder
Zero imperative addEventListener spaghetti: all UI interactions hooked declaratively
Full Preview serves the selected workspace files from the browser to the preview tab
1-Click Standalone Pop-out Preview with live updates from the editor
Workspace Folder Explorer (Open Folder via showDirectoryPicker with recursive tree)
Quick Open File Switcher Palette (Ctrl+P) with fuzzy workspace search
Multi-document tabbed buffer strip with isolated Monaco text models
Compact 22px Studio Status Bar (Ln/Col, UTF-8, Spaces, Language, Alt+Z Word Wrap)
Native File System Access API (Direct disk persistence via Ctrl+S)
